sam_peopleops: thanks everyone — short follow-up from the all-hands Q&A. heard a few edge-case questions about promotions/comp that we should answer here so managers have a single reference.
nana_peopleops: yes! can we call out the most common edge cases so managers don't have to DM us individually? :)
tara_total_rewards: happy to. common ones i've seen: mid-cycle promotions (retro pay), IC->manager transitions, leveling exceptions for ICs with cross-functional scope, and external hire comp compression.
emily_ceo: big ask: can we clarify timeline and what managers should tell folks today vs. later? customers (internal) want clear language.
raj_prod: +1 on messaging. also flag: if a candidate got an offer last month and we moved bands, what's the anchor for comp?
mike_engineering: two quick practical asks from eng: 1) if someone gets promoted but their manager leaves before paperwork, who signs off for retro? 2) can we give a short script managers can use in 1:1s?
jordan_engineering_manager: also curious about the eligibility window for bonuses when promos happen in the review/paycycle.
nana_peopleops: good list — i'll answer each briefly below and share a tiny manager checklist. feel free to copy/paste.

ana_peopleops: Q1: retro pay for mid-cycle promos
- short answer: eligible if promotion effective date is before the payroll cutoff for the current paycycle AND approval is completed within the same compensation cycle. retro is to the effective date, not the approval date.
- process: manager submits promo packet -> people ops reviews -> payroll processes retro in next pay run (if within cutoff). if missed cutoff, retro is applied next month.

ana_peopleops: Q2: IC -> manager transitions (leveling and comp)
- leveling: we calibrate role expectations vs rubric. some transitions will have a holdback period (3 months) for sign-off if responsibilities are still ramping.
- comp: base salary offers are adjusted at promotion; bonus eligibility follows the compensation policy (pro-rated in promo month).

na...oops copy error: ignore line

ana_peopleops: Q3: leveling exceptions & cross-functional scope
- exceptions are rare. manager provides rationale + evidence (projects, scope, org impact). drumbeat: include examples of work aligned to the target level.
- triage: we route to Calibration Committee; expect ~10 business days for decision.

ana_peopleops: Q4: external hire compression (new hire offers vs existing teammates)
- principle: we don't reduce existing team members to match offers. if compression exists, we evaluate "compression relief" during the next comp cycle; managers can raise urgent cases via the compensation queue.

ana_peopleops: Q5: signing-off when manager leaves mid-process
- fallback: skip-level manager or director signs. if that person is also unavailable, HR/People Ops steps in to ensure approvals aren't blocked. include decision notes in the promo packet.

ana_peopleops: Q6: bonus eligibility when promo within a quarter/paycycle
- rule: bonuses are tied to the payout policy. if promo effective date < payout calculation date, bonus uses the new title/band for payout eligibility; otherwise it's based on prior role. Managers: escalate edge cases to Total Rewards.

ana_peopleops: manager checklist (copyable snippet):
```
- Confirm promotion effective date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Attach promotion rationale & evidence (OKR impact, product metrics, code/arch PRs)
- Confirm new comp figure & justification
- Identify signer (skip-level if necessary)
- Submit packet to people-ops@redwood.in with subject: "Promo Packet - <name>"
- Mark if retro pay requested and include effective date
```

tara_total_rewards: tagging in the calc rules doc: https://redwood.in/comp/guide (link) — Q re: proration: we pro-rate bonuses based on days in band during the performance period.

mike_engineering: re: manager script, can we add something simple?
jordan_engineering_manager: yes please — short, human, avoids legal parlance.

ana_peopleops: manager script (short):
"Hi <name>, congrats — we're promoting you to <new title> effective <date>. This reflects your impact on <project/metric>. You'll see the comp change in payroll on <approx date>. People Ops will follow up with the paperwork — reach out to me or people-ops@redwood.in if you have questions"

sam_peopleops: perfect. can we also clarify parental leave interactions? one question was: does promo clock pause if someone goes on leave?

tara_total_rewards: parental leave note: promotions can still be effective during leave if manager recommends and evidence exists. time on leave does not automatically pause promotion consideration. however, calibration may ask for additional context about performance evidence.

emily_ceo: important to call out equity changes: will RSU vesting schedule change on promotion?

tara_total_rewards: short answer: promotions don't change existing grant schedules. new grants (if any) follow the grant policy and will be communicated separately.

sam_peopleops: logistics — i'll make a slim one-pager with the checklist + script + links to docs and post it in #managers. aim to publish by EOD tomorrow. any objections?
emily_ceo: no objections. thanks for moving fast. :tada:
raj_prod: thanks — pls cc product leadership when you post.
mike_engineering: can we get a short office hours slot for managers next week? 20 mins to run through sample packets.

ana_peopleops: yes — booking 2 sessions: Tue 11am PT and Thu 4pm PT. calendar invites on their way.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Promo packet template v2 uploaded to Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/example (auto-note)

sam_peopleops: awesome, appreciate the quick answers. if you hit an edge case, drop it here and we'll triage. :slightly_smiling_face:
